default/30402.htm.text: Newbie Helper: I bid you welcome, young one. I am a guardian of the Mother Tree Glade, and serve the Mother of all Elves. I will be teaching you the basics of combat. To begin click on Quest , in the Chat window.

Q00255_Tutorial/30402-001.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Welcome, my young friend. I guard the Mother Tree, mother of all Elves. I shall teach you the basics of combat. Click Quest in the chat window.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
